Okay everybody, let's start the lesson. Today we are going to practise the present perfect continuous. Open your books at page forty-two. Look at exercise three. The structure is have been plus the ing form of the verb. We use it to talk about an action that started in the past and is still going on now. For example, I have been studying English for five years. Notice the difference with present perfect simple. Now work in pairs and make five sentences about your own life. Then we will check them together. Do not forget the homework, exercises four and five, for next Tuesday.
